_: The map regions (agents/MAP.md §8.10): id, name, claim and the sign scene – read by scripts/region-signs.mjs (the welcome signs) and scripts/map-regions-seed.mjs (the pre-drawn covers, the seed migration). Names and claims to refine (owner).

regions.name: Dünenmeer Magenta
regions.scene: glowing dunes drifting from tangerine into hot magenta and turquoise, neon-pink salt pans, black rock ridges with glowing veins, a lone camel-like creature
regions.industrial: A sand-blasted enamel welcome sign on riveted steel posts at a desert highway, half buried by a magenta dune; glowing tangerine-to-magenta dunes, a salt flat and black rock ridges behind, a heat shimmer.

regions.name: Hochland Regenbogen
regions.scene: golden steppe grass, rainbow-striped mountains like Vinicunca, turquoise lagoons, a llama
regions.industrial: A big painted billboard on a rusty steel truss frame by a high-plain road, the billboard illustrated with rainbow mountains; behind it the real altiplano – golden grass, rainbow-striped mountains, a turquoise lagoon, a llama by the road.

regions.name: Ewigschnee
regions.scene: glittering snowy peaks in electric cyan and lilac, frosted pines, a cosy wooden chalet, icicles hanging from the sign
regions.industrial: Like the "Welcome to Twin Peaks" sign: a big hand-painted wooden board on two weathered posts at the edge of a lonely mountain road, the painting on the board shows two snowy peaks and dark pines; behind it the real deep-winter Alps glowing in cyan and lilac, snow banks along the road.

regions.name: Schuppenwald
regions.scene: dense emerald jungle canopy, iridescent lizard scales, a gecko peeking over the sign, steaming electric-blue swamp pools
regions.industrial: Like the Frankenmuth welcome arch, but industrial and overgrown: a rusted steel truss arch spanning a jungle road, the name in big welded steel letters on top, the claim on a hanging enamel plate; vines, giant leaves and a big iridescent lizard on the arch; steaming emerald jungle behind.

regions.name: Fracktal
regions.scene: cracked sulphur-yellow crust, rusty drilling rigs, oily rainbow pools, radioactive green glow; the sign bent and patched, still proud
regions.industrial: Like a roadside LED trailer sign ("Welcome to Hawaii"): a battered orange mobile LED message board on a small trailer, the name glowing in amber LED dots, the claim on a dented steel plate bolted underneath, traffic cones around it; behind it a toxic fracking wasteland – drilling rigs, sulphur-yellow cracked ground, oily rainbow pools, a radioactive green haze.

regions.name: Juwelenarchipel
regions.scene: little islands made of opal, malachite, rose quartz and lapis in a candy-blue sea, a shell and pearls
regions.industrial: An industrial signal mast at a small ferry terminal: enamel plates with the name and the claim bolted to a steel lattice mast with a lamp on top, a mooring bollard and rope; behind it little islands of opal, malachite and rose quartz in a candy-blue sea.

regions.name: Erzberge
regions.scene: green lowlands rising into huge, grim, jagged snowy mountains, rust-red ore slopes, a mining pick and hammer crest, a small monastery clinging to a cliff
regions.industrial: Like the real "Glück Auf! in Eisenerz" town sign (where the Erzberg story was shot): a big white municipal board in a heavy rusted corten-steel frame on steel legs, a small coat of arms with crossed hammer and pick in the upper corner, the line "Glück Auf!" above the name, a long maroon banner plate under it carrying the claim; behind it a winter mining valley – snow on the slopes, a giant terraced ore mountain, pine forest, a few old miners' houses.
